finance.question: 按分支和客户等级统计 2015 年交易额，列出前 5 名

hq_admin.sql: SELECT dim_customer.Tier AS Tier, dim_broker.Branch AS Branch, SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer AS dim_customer ON fact_trades.SK_CustomerID = dim_customer.SK_CustomerID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker AS dim_broker ON fact_trades.SK_BrokerID = dim_broker.SK_BrokerID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2015 AND 1 = 1 GROUP BY dim_customer.Tier, dim_broker.Branch ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 5

branch_manager.sql: SELECT dim_customer.Tier AS Tier, dim_broker.Branch AS Branch, SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer AS dim_customer ON fact_trades.SK_CustomerID = dim_customer.SK_CustomerID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker AS dim_broker ON fact_trades.SK_BrokerID = dim_broker.SK_BrokerID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2015 AND dim_broker.branch = 'uHtbMrIxbLVfWHFhCIeAnTu' GROUP BY dim_customer.Tier, dim_broker.Branch ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 5

compliance_auditor.sql: SELECT dim_customer.Tier AS Tier, dim_broker.Branch AS Branch, SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer AS dim_customer ON fact_trades.SK_CustomerID = dim_customer.SK_CustomerID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker AS dim_broker ON fact_trades.SK_BrokerID = dim_broker.SK_BrokerID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2015 AND dim_customer.tier <= 3 GROUP BY dim_customer.Tier, dim_broker.Branch ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 5

retail.question: 2000 年按门店城市和品类统计销售额，列出前 3 名

claims.note: claims 值取自 eval/gold/retail/data-profile.md 实测值域

hq_admin.sql: SELECT dim_item.i_category AS i_category, dim_store.s_city AS s_city, SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price FROM atlas.dwd.store_sales AS store_sales INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.date_dim AS dim_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dim_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_item AS dim_item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = dim_item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_store AS dim_store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = dim_store.s_store_sk WHERE dim_date.d_year = 2000 AND 1 = 1 GROUP BY dim_item.i_category, dim_store.s_city ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC LIMIT 3

region_manager.sql: SELECT dim_item.i_category AS i_category, dim_store.s_city AS s_city, SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price FROM atlas.dwd.store_sales AS store_sales INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.date_dim AS dim_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dim_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_item AS dim_item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = dim_item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_store AS dim_store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = dim_store.s_store_sk WHERE dim_date.d_year = 2000 AND dim_store.s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY dim_item.i_category, dim_store.s_city ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC LIMIT 3

category_analyst.sql: SELECT dim_item.i_category AS i_category, dim_store.s_city AS s_city, SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price FROM atlas.dwd.store_sales AS store_sales INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.date_dim AS dim_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dim_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_item AS dim_item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = dim_item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_store AS dim_store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = dim_store.s_store_sk WHERE dim_date.d_year = 2000 AND (dim_store.s_state = 'TN' AND dim_item.i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Electronics')) GROUP BY dim_item.i_category, dim_store.s_city ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC LIMIT 3

note: 各域同一问句经同一编译器/Guard 链，仅 JWT 角色不同；谓词注入发生在 SQL 层（Guard 别名对齐后二次只读校验），非应用层过滤。零售档 region_manager（州=TN）与 hq_admin 结果一致：SF0.1 单州数据下州谓词无过滤效果（数据事实，差异验证由 category_analyst 品类受限承担）。
